# Public regex patterns (case-insensitive). One per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Customer and project names do NOT go here. See scripts/check-banned-terms.mjs.

# Microsoft employee email addresses
[a-z0-9._%+-]+@microsoft\.com
# Tenant / object GUIDs
\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b
# Real SharePoint / OneDrive tenant hosts (fictional contoso and fabrikam are allowed)
\b(?!(contoso|fabrikam)(-my)?\.sharepoint)[a-z0-9-]+(-my)?\.sharepoint\.com
# Microsoft internal hosts
\b(microsoft\.visualstudio\.com|dev\.azure\.com/microsoft|eng\.ms|corp\.microsoft\.com|msit\.)
# Confidentiality markers copied from internal documents
\b(microsoft confidential|internal only|under nda|nda only|do not share externally)\b
# Superlatives that can identify one organisation ("the largest bank in Indonesia")
\bthe (largest|biggest|only|first|sole) (state|sovereign|bank|insurer|holding|miner|telco|plantation|operator|conglomerate|fund)\b
\b(largest|biggest) [a-z ]{0,30}in (indonesia|malaysia|asean|southeast asia)\b
